title: MSVC C2447 / C2825 syntax error caused by misspelled export macro EZ_COLONY_PLUGIN_DLL
description: During compilation of Modules 94 and 95, MSVC failed with C2447 ('{': missing function header) and C2825 ('left of :: must be a class/struct/union').
root_cause: The export macro in ColonyPluginDLL.h is defined as EZ_COLONYPLUGIN_DLL (no underscore between COLONY and PLUGIN). The new headers defined classes using EZ_COLONY_PLUGIN_DLL, which was undefined and led the compiler to parse subsequent tokens as malformed expressions.
resolution: Applied search-and-replace to update EZ_COLONY_PLUGIN_DLL to EZ_COLONYPLUGIN_DLL in ColonyFungalSporeSystem.h and ColonyOrbitalLaserShieldSystem.h. Full compilation succeeded cleanly with 0 warnings.
